summary: A friendly list: the big seven are gimmes, and Mississauga, Brampton and Vancouver at only #8 make the twist. Works as a daily list and is an even better Blitz.
reasons: Casual run: 8/10 (Toronto through Hamilton), but Quebec City (#12), Halifax (#13), Victoria, Niagara Falls and Regina burned all five lives. The near misses teach the municipality-vs-metro point, so it stings but is fair.
Fan gets 10/10 losing only Quebec City. Values match the 2021 census, the latest released; the 2026 counts are not out yet.
Blitz is deep: 24 of 26 casual names scored (Saskatoon, Kelowna, Fredericton, Thunder Bay all count). Only Whistler and Banff are unrecognized.
fixes: Junk redirect aliases on top-10 entries (not names of the city): Toronto 'Highways within Greater Toronto Area', 'Toronto, ontario Part 2'; Montreal 'Montreal Skyline', 'Team990'; Calgary 'Foothills Major Baseball Association', 'Fmba', 'Calgary Cardinals FMBA', 'Prairie Winds Park'; Ottawa 'National Capital Baseball League', 'NCBL', 'Antrim, Ontario', 'Cedardale, Ottawa, Ontario', 'Technically Beautiful'; Edmonton '18 Street, Edmonton', '159 Street, Edmonton', '18 Street NW, Edmonton', "Canada's Largest Baseball Bat"; Mississauga 'Neighbourhoods of Churchill, Mississauga, Ontario', 'Sommerville Manor School', 'Sommerville Manor', 'Applewood Acres', "St. Jude's Academy", 'The Maples Academy'; Vancouver 'Greater Vancouver Bridges', 'Vancouver Christian School', 'Vancouver City Centre, British Columbia'; Brampton 'Rowntree Montessori Schools'; Hamilton 'Beverly Hills 4, Ontario', 'MacNab Street Presbyterian Church', 'Eastport Drive', 'Pleasant Valley, Hamilton, Ontario'. Drop redirects naming schools, streets, churches, leagues, radio stations, parks and neighbourhoods.
Drop derogatory nickname redirects 'Bramladesh' (Brampton) and 'Hong couver' / 'Hong kouver' (Vancouver).
Optional intent aliases that are currently unrecognized (free, but the player gets no credit): 'The Six' / 'The 6ix' for Toronto, 'MTL' for Montreal, 'YYC' for Calgary.
